annotations.title: Start a session without a tab

description: Starts a Motion session when the user has no pairing code. Compositions can be created and edited at once; the returned link opens the session in a browser. Rendering frames, playback and anything touching media need that tab open (see wait_for_tab). The scene is kept for 24 hours after the last change.
name: create_session
title: Start a session without a tab
